title: ‘Two Marcoses, two Aquinos’: Kris jokes about breaking presidential ‘tie’
summary: Queen of All Media Kris Aquino brought humor to Malacañan Palace on Saturday, playfully teasing President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. about their families' deadlocked count in the Philippine presidency.
